info.title: Voidwall HTTP API
info.description: Detect PII in arbitrary text, JSON, CSV, and TSV bodies with `POST /v1/scan`, the one route this listener serves. The body itself is the content to scan — there is no JSON envelope. The `Content-Type` header drives parsing.

post.summary: Scan a request body for PII
post.description:
Inspects the body for PII according to the configured detector set and
returns the kinds detected along with per-kind match counts. The body
itself is never echoed back.

requestBody.description: Raw body content to scan for PII. The `Content-Type` header determines how the body is parsed and scanned.

400.description: Body could not be parsed for the declared `Content-Type`

413.description: Body exceeds configured `max_body_size`, or, with `on_error = fail_close`, a model guard needs more windows than its limit

415.description: `Content-Type` is not in the configured allowlist

500.description: A guard failed (scanner or model inference) and `on_error = fail_close`

error.description: Human-readable error description. Never contains matched PII values.

example.error: malformed body for declared content type

detected.description: Whether any PII was detected in the body.

kinds.description:
Distinct PII kinds detected (e.g. `EMAIL`, `US_SSN`). Operator-defined
custom labels surface here using their configured `label`. The full
list of built-in labels is appended to this description at
spec-generation time.
